paper.title: Class-conditional LDM-4 on ImageNet 256 (Section 4.3, Table 3 / Appendix)

note: The paper reports FID 3.60 for LDM-4 on class-conditional ImageNet with classifier-free guidance scale 1.5 (250 DDIM steps). Channel multipliers, iteration counts and the autoencoder (the paper uses VQ-f4 / KL-f4/f8 first stages trained with LPIPS + PatchGAN) are best-recalled values; check the paper's appendix tables (Tables 12-15). LPIPS is not implemented (needs pretrained VGG). Requires an ImageNet loader; the train loop uses synthetic images. The paper's original class conditioning uses cross-attention on a learned class embedding, as implemented here.
